title: Advancing Block Diffusion Language Models for Test-Time Scaling
authors_zh: Yi Lu、Tao Gui、Xuanjing Huang（复旦大学）；Deyang Kong、Qi Guo、Wei Ye、Shikun Zhang（北京大学）；Jianing Wang、Linsen Guo、Xue Wang、Wei Wang（美团 LongCat 团队）
paper_type_zh: 块扩散语言模型的测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 希望比较非自回归推理扩展机制与采样预算机制的读者。
one_line: The paper makes block-diffusion reasoning scale at test time by adapting denoising and using coarse exploration followed by fine-grained critique.
该研究让块扩散推理在测试时同时自适应控制去噪和推理块大小，以平衡探索、细化与速度。
why: It measures an alternative compute unit—block size and denoising work—while exposing the accuracy-speed trade-off on long reasoning.
inclusion_reason: It explicitly studies how decoding and reasoning-block budgets alter the efficiency and quality of inference-time scaling.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Most test-time scaling studies add autoregressive samples, branches, or verifier calls. Block diffusion language models offer parallel denoising and flexible generation blocks, but long reasoning makes their trade-off sharper: too much denoising is slow, while large blocks can accumulate errors and too little exploration can miss a solution.

This paper asks how a block diffusion reasoner should spend inference work on difficult chain-of-thought tasks. It treats both local decoding effort and the granularity of a reasoning block as allocation choices, seeking a procedure that accelerates easy portions without sacrificing the fine correction needed near an uncertain conclusion.

多数测试时扩展研究增加的是自回归样本、搜索分支或验证器调用。块扩散语言模型具备并行去噪和灵活生成块的能力，但长推理会放大权衡：去噪过多会变慢，块过大可能累积错误，探索不足又可能错过解答。

本文研究块扩散推理器在困难思维链任务上应如何花费推理计算。它把局部解码工作和推理块粒度都视为资源分配选择，目标是在简单部分加速，同时保留接近不确定结论时所需的细致修正能力。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The proposal has two complementary controls. Bounded Adaptive Confidence Decoding, or BACD, changes how much denoising is performed according to model confidence, aiming to avoid unnecessary iterations while bounding error accumulation. Think Coarse, Critic Fine, or TCCF, uses large blocks while exploring a reasoning path and smaller blocks while revising it.

Progressive Block Size Extension makes the large-block regime usable by reducing the degradation that otherwise appears when block length grows. The result is not a selector over many completed answers. It is a test-time policy inside the diffusion decoder, where the produced record is a sequence of reasoning blocks whose resolution and denoising budget vary over the trajectory.

方案包含两个互补控制。有限自适应置信度解码 BACD 根据模型置信度改变去噪量，意在避免不必要的迭代，同时控制错误累积。粗思细评 TCCF 则在探索推理路径时使用大块，在修订路径时改用较小块。

渐进式块大小扩展使大块机制可用，减轻块长度增长时原本会出现的性能下降。结果不是在许多完整答案之间做选择，而是在扩散解码器内部执行的测试时策略：生成记录是一串推理块，其分辨率和去噪预算会沿轨迹变化。

title: Method
方法
html:
The authors begin with TDAR-8B-Thinking, then apply Progressive Block Size Extension so that larger generation blocks remain viable. During decoding, BACD uses confidence to select denoising behavior. During reasoning, TCCF assigns coarse blocks to broad exploration and fine blocks to the critic-style refinement phase. These controls act jointly rather than treating speed and reasoning quality as separate post-processing problems.

Evaluation compares TDAR variants with diffusion and block-diffusion baselines using mathematical reasoning, reporting accuracy and token-per-forward style efficiency. The paper also releases code and models through the TDAR repository. For a replication, the relevant unit is not merely the output answer: it is the chosen sequence of block sizes, denoising work, and final refinement under the reported inference configuration.

作者以 TDAR-8B-Thinking 为起点，再采用渐进式块大小扩展，使更大的生成块仍能有效工作。解码期间，BACD 根据置信度选择去噪行为；推理期间，TCCF 为广泛探索分配粗块，为类似批评者的细化阶段分配细块。这些控制联合起作用，而非把速度和推理质量当作彼此独立的后处理问题。

评测把 TDAR 变体与扩散和块扩散基线进行数学推理比较，报告准确率及每次前向令牌等效率指标。论文还通过 TDAR 仓库发布代码和模型。复现时，关键单位不只是输出答案，而是在所报告推理配置下选择的一串块大小、去噪工作量和最终细化操作。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The clearest headline result is on AIME24 average-at-8. The PDF reports that TDAR-8B with BACD and TCCF improves over the strong TraDo-8B baseline by 11.2 accuracy points while reaching a 2.26-fold speedup. Its front-page figure separately reports 11.7 percentage points and 1.71-fold speedup for the illustrated configuration, so readers should retain the exact configuration attached to either number rather than combine them.

This evidence supports the paper's efficiency-effectiveness claim within its TDAR benchmark setting. It does not establish that confidence-controlled diffusion decoding dominates autoregressive sampling on all models, nor that token-per-forward is a substitute for end-to-end serving latency. The released implementation is valuable because the block schedule is central to the claim and cannot be reconstructed from a final-answer score alone.

最清晰的标题结果来自 AIME24 的 average-at-8。PDF 报告，加入 BACD 和 TCCF 的 TDAR-8B 相比强基线 TraDo-8B 提升 11.2 个准确率点，并实现 2.26 倍加速。首页图示对所示配置另报 11.7 个百分点和 1.71 倍加速，因此读者应保留每个数字对应的准确配置，而不要把它们混合。

这些证据支持 TDAR 基准设置内的效率—效果主张。它并未证明置信度控制的扩散解码在所有模型上都优于自回归采样，也未证明每次前向令牌可以替代端到端服务延迟。发布的实现很重要，因为块调度是该主张的核心，无法从最终答案分数单独重建。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest work scales test-time reasoning by producing more full candidates or by changing a conventional decoder's sampling rule. This paper instead makes the diffusion model's internal generation resolution a first-class resource: BACD controls local denoising, and TCCF changes block size according to whether the trajectory is exploring or refining. That coupling is the auditable new decision surface.

The contribution is not a new external reward model or a generic claim that block diffusion is faster. Its novelty is the two-level allocation policy and the accompanying comparison on long reasoning. Before transferring the result, readers should inspect whether confidence remains meaningful at larger blocks, whether the refinement critic is robust to early errors, and whether the same schedule survives a different diffusion backbone.

最接近的工作通常通过生成更多完整候选，或改变常规解码器的采样规则来扩展测试时推理。本文改而把扩散模型内部的生成分辨率设为一等资源：BACD 控制局部去噪，TCCF 则根据轨迹是在探索还是细化来改变块大小。这种耦合就是可审计的新决策面。

贡献不在于新的外部奖励模型，也不在于笼统宣称块扩散更快。新意是双层资源分配策略以及与长推理相配套的比较。迁移该结果前，读者应检查置信度在更大块上是否仍有意义，细化批评者是否能抵抗早期错误，以及同一调度是否适用于不同的扩散骨干。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The reported gain is tied to TDAR-8B, its mathematical reasoning setup, and the particular block and denoising schedules. Confidence errors can make BACD save work at precisely the wrong time, while coarse blocks may introduce mistakes that later refinement cannot repair. The paper reports speed through decoder-oriented measures; deployment should additionally benchmark batching, memory pressure, wall-clock latency, and model-quality changes at each block size. The code is public, but users must verify model and benchmark licenses before reuse.
所报告的收益绑定于 TDAR-8B、其数学推理设置以及特定的块和去噪调度。置信度错误可能使 BACD 恰在不该节省工作时节省；粗块也可能引入后续细化无法修复的错误。论文用面向解码器的指标报告速度；部署还应测试批处理、显存压力、墙钟延迟和各块大小下的模型质量变化。代码虽已公开，复用前仍须核验模型和基准许可证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this paper when the inference stack uses a diffusion or block-diffusion language model and the resource knob is richer than the number of completed samples. It supplies a concrete vocabulary for logging a run: block size, denoising steps, confidence, exploration/refinement phase, token-per-forward, and final accuracy. The official TDAR repository is the practical starting point, but an engineering comparison should hold task, model quality, decoding temperature, and end-to-end latency constant before attributing gains to the scheduling policy.
当推理栈使用扩散或块扩散语言模型，且资源旋钮不止是完成样本数时，可使用本文。它提供了记录一次运行的具体词汇：块大小、去噪步数、置信度、探索或细化阶段、每次前向令牌和最终准确率。官方 TDAR 仓库是实践起点，但工程比较应固定任务、模型质量、解码温度和端到端延迟，再把收益归因于调度策略。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The paper changes the compute unit from “another complete sample” to “another amount of denoising at a chosen block resolution.” BACD is the local confidence-sensitive decoder control, while TCCF is the trajectory-level coarse-to-fine schedule. Progressive Block Size Extension is needed because large blocks alone degrade quality. Keep the two reported speed/accuracy headline configurations separate, and treat the public TDAR code as necessary evidence for reproducing the claimed schedule.
本文把计算单位从“再增加一个完整样本”改为“在选定块分辨率上增加一定去噪工作”。BACD 是局部的置信度敏感解码控制，TCCF 是轨迹层面的由粗到细调度；之所以需要渐进式块大小扩展，是因为单独增大块会降低质量。应区分两个速度和准确率标题数字对应的配置，并把公开 TDAR 代码视为复现该调度的必要证据。
